senses.gloss:
जटमल्ल of the Kośala family, king of Svarṇapurī, brother
of Dhāyamalla, son of Bālacandra, son of Ḍhola,
son of Malladeva, son of Jayacandradeva, was patron
of the author of the following work.

जटमल्लविलास dh. by Śrīdhara. IO. 1149. 1441. NW.
112. NP. VI, 24.
जटमल्लविलास add Sūcīpattra 28 (equally poor copy).

जटाघनसंग्रह modifications of the kramapāṭha of the
Veda. Oppert II, 747.
जटादर्पण Oppert 7136. 7186.

जटाधर कविराज father of Jagannāthasena (Chando-
mañjarīṭīkā).

जटाधर brother of Sumeru, father of Bāṇeśvara, grand-
father of Nārāyaṇa Vidyāvinoda (Bhaṭṭikāvyaṭkā, etc.).
Oxf. 181^b. IO. 1594. 1637.

जटाधर son of Raghupati:
 Abhidhānatantra.
जटाधर brother of Sumeru. read L. instead of IO.

जटापटल a complicated mode of the kramapāṭha of the
Ṛgveda, attributed to Hayagrīva. W. p. 95 (and C.).
96. L. 1234. Rādh 1. 2. NW. 12. 14. NP. V,
142. Burnell 3^b. P. 4. Bhk. 9. Rice 12. SB. 8.
 C. Vikṛtikaumudī by Gaṅgādharācārya. NP. V,
142. Bhk. 9.
 C. by Dayāśaṅkara. L. 1525. NW. 12. Bhr. 513.
 C. by Śukla Mathurānātha. NW. 2.
 C. Jaṭādyaṣṭavikṛti by Madhusūdana. L. 1492.
1931. K. 78. Haug 30. NP. V, 142. BP.
286. (and C.). Sūcīpattra 111. SB. 8.
 C. by Śivarāma. NW. 12.

जटापटल by Anantācārya. Bkh. 9.
[]
जटापटल C. by Madhusūdana. add Bhk. 9.
जटापटल by Anantācārya. read Bhk.

जटापटल called विकृतिवल्ली attributed to Vyāḍi.
Cs. 35. 36. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 84 (and Vikṛti-
kaumudī).
 C. Vikṛtikaumudī by Gaṅgādhara. Cs. 35. 37.

जटापटल attributed to Hayagrīva. CU. add. 1910.
Bhau Dāji 74. 121.
 C. by Dayāśaṅkara. CU. add. 1910.

जटामणि relates to the mode of preservation of the
Veda in the jaṭā form. Oppert 982. 7137. 7547.
II, 748. 1320. 9875. C. II, 749.
जटामणि read Oppert II, 9879 instead of 9875.
जटामणि Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 28.

जटामणि vaid. by Vemānabhairava. Hz. 1436 p. 134.
C. Hz. 1437.
जटावबोधिनी Nalodayaṭīkā, by Ravideva. B. 2, 88.

जटावल्ली on the jaṭā of the Veda. Oppert 983. 2327.
7188. II, 750. 1319. 7954.
जटासिद्धान्तचन्द्रिका Oppert 984. II, 9880.

जटासिद्धान्तचन्द्रिका vaid. a C. on the Jaṭāsiddhāntaviciti.
Hz. 1438 p. 134.
जटिशिलामाहात्म्य Oppert 5043.

जटोदाहरण effects of saṃdhi in forming the jaṭā of
the Ṛv. Burnell 3^b.

जयमङ्गल, called also जटीश्वर, जयदेव
 Bhaṭṭikāvyaṭīkā.
 Sūryaśatakaṭīkā. L. 1643.
 Jayamaṅgala is quoted by Puruṣottamadeva in
Varṇadeśanā, by Bhaṭṭoji Oxf. 162^b, by Cā-
ritravardhana and Hemādri on Raghuvaṃśa.

जटालक्षणकारिकाः by Vyāḍi and C. by Anantācārya.
Bhau Dāji 121.
